description: This file contains the definition of a Swift class 'TalkOverlayController' responsible for managing the talk overlay UI component in a macOS application. It includes methods for presenting, dismissing, and updating the overlay's state, as well as managing the associated window and views. It also defines a private hosting view class for integrating SwiftUI views.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A final class managing the overlay's presentation, dismissal, and state updates within a macOS app using SwiftUI.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A private subclass of NSHostingView that accepts first mouse events to interact with the overlay.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the overlay window, initializing it if necessary, and sets up the view hierarchy.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hides and removes the overlay window from view.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the phase state of the overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Adjusts the overlay's level between 0 and 1.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window if it exists.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window if it does not already exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the target frame for positioning the overlay window.
